title: Correspondence of the Family of Haddock, 1657-1719 The Camden Miscellany: Volume the Eighth

The letters reveal the close-knit nature of the Haddock family, highlighting personal details such as Richard's relationship with his wife and his worries for their safety amidst the political tensions of the time.
